added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs gates/base-picker.log (1 failed, 246 passed) and gates/after-picker.log (1 failed, 262 passed); the only failing id is tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py::test_rendered_state_matches_the_base_revision_bytes on both arms, so the added count is zero. The reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite keys; these test_logs are the equivalents read here.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: A routine node at full headroom is offered the reserved lane, which happens when the reserved-lane scan is removed.
A hardest-tier node at or above the ceiling, or on an unknown reading, is offered the reserved lane.
A node one attempt below the policy count is offered the reserved lane.
The answer's reason is dropped between the pick and the run record, or the reserved lane is not named on the selection.
A reserved-lane route with no reason is not refused and re-ask #2 still shows the lane, which is the unreasoned-pick guard.

findings.text: follow-on: a debugging print(', DIAG', ...) is left on the committed test line, emitting stray output on every run of the tier-with-headroom case.

follow-on: the attempts-from-ledger enumeration duplicates reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:422-428 verbatim; the comment claims the policy and the rendered state can never disagree about the figure, yet they are two independent copies that would drift if one is changed.

follow-on: _reserved_lane_floor_met re-implements the level-ranking comparison already owned by reckon/capability.py:208 _rank (used by worker_satisfies at capability.py:227) rather than extending it, so a second rank-in-levels implementation now exists.

follow-on: the unreasoned-reserved-lane refusal re-picks only when allow is true; a nested re-ask runs with allow=False (set at dispatch_picker.py:929), so a reserved lane reached there can be routed with no reason while the log records refused_unreasoned true.

item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md:4-23 records status complete, commit 90ee4ee1a03f0de6ac7863d22e30c3da2ddb4972, 16 passing tests, a delta-zero claim, the four gate logs and the negative-control log; it carries no baseline_suite/after_suite keys and states the schema-source write as a follow-on.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source brief.md:56 grants seven paths; the base-to-head diff changes five of them (reckon/flight.py, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py, reckon/crew/picker/templates/questions.jinja, tests/test_picker_reserved_lanes.py) and touches nothing outside them.

justifications.fit: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1023 and reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:749 carry mechanism-named symbols and reuse _ask_excluding_lane and _append_crew_log_line, matching the surrounding idiom; one stray debug print is left at tests/test_picker_reserved_lanes.py:243.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1273 withholds the reserved lane unless the floor or the attempt count is met and the window is below ceiling, and reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:749 records the reason, so all five brief items are met; the schema item lands through the reckon-owned-key pattern at reckon/flight.py:741 rather than the LinkML source.
justifications.reuse: The policy reader extends the flight-config owner at reckon/flight.py:842 and the re-ask reuses the existing _ask_excluding_lane, but reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1163 re-inlines the attempts-from-rows enumeration owned by reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:422-428 and snapshot.py:995 re-implements the level ranking owned by reckon/capability.py:208.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff from 35aae9475ddccae7d3675a520fd0b540042d7fca to 90ee4ee1a03f0de6ac7863d22e30c3da2ddb4972 changes only five of the seven granted paths, leaving reckon/crew/picker/templates/state.jinja and reckon/_flight_schema.py untouched.
